The source archive contains the unmodified Notion REST handlers, shared TypeScript service kit, Prisma schema and Apache-2.0 license from [Mirage](https://github.com/strukto-ai/mirage/tree/ccfaa92485fe0bcbbdf5ff393b6e7e5ab1388f53/integ/server/notion), the commit selected by VFS-Bench 1. The npm lock includes the upstream Notion MCP server 1.9.0 and the Mirage Prisma 6.19.3 and tsx 4.21.0 dependencies. At trial startup the adapter mounts the original Toolathlon OpenAPI specification and the task's captured SQLite seed rows. The two launcher and transport scripts are provided by VFS-Bench.
